summary.short_summary: The meeting revolved around a proposed acquisition of Cool Cool Co, suggesting an 80-90% stock offer alongside a 10-20% cash component, with a full exit anticipated by 2027 and a valuation pegged at 3-4 million EBITDA. Challenges were highlighted in negotiations with the founder, described as 'slippery,' necessitating pressure for disclosure. The company has transitioned entirely to a SaaS business model, which is enhancing outreach to previously uninterested software firms and strengthening market positioning. Banyan plans to re-engage in 12 months to review customer retention metrics following a track record establishment. With the company nearing a 2 million EBITDA threshold, private equity interest has emerged, notably with Lloyds as a potential funding source. Stuart is exploring grants from Innovate UK and Uruguay. The updated Information Memorandum reflects an 85% client retention rate and significant client updates, while the organization has grown to about 25 employees, with Tom Cowie leading RMI and new client acquisitions from Co-op and Mood Media. A meeting with Brand Crush founder at Criteo is scheduled for potential backfill opportunities, with a slow M&A activity anticipated during July-August and a new outreach campaign planned within 2-3 weeks.
